title: Bytes held by each bucket, largest first

items.description: One entry per bucket measured, largest first. A bucket that could not be measured has no entry and an error (scoped to monitoring for the buckets Cloud Monitoring has no series for)

sizeBytes.description: Bytes the bucket holds, summed over byType (Cloud Monitoring storage/v2/total_bytes), or the live objects' bytes when source is du

overThreshold.description: sizeTiB is above the usageThresholdTib setting

source.description: Where the size comes from: Cloud Monitoring, or (single-bucket targets only, when Monitoring has no series for the bucket) gcloud storage du

byType.description: Bytes by object type: live-object, noncurrent-object, soft-deleted-object, multipart-upload (Monitoring); {live-object} when source is du. At most 50 types

omitted.description: Buckets left out of the run by maxItems
